NoteForge Desktop runs entirely offline. Network access is needed only for optional synchronization and downloads.

/noteforge/docs/create.body:
Create a local note in NoteForge Desktop

Select New note and enter text. New notes are saved in the local vault on your computer.

/noteforge/docs/edit.body:
Edit local notes in NoteForge Desktop

Open an existing local note, change its text and save. Changes are written to your local vault. Other products may require an online account; this guide applies to NoteForge Desktop.
